stance_rationale: Forge realized backtest is not approval-grade: portfolio alpha t_NW=2.3497 fails the 2.95 hurdle, MDD=58.79% breaches the 45% hard fail, and 5-spec Harvey/DSR/baseline fairness artifacts are absent. Pure-function hashes and basic time-series weights pass, but those positives do not rescue the failed hurdle and incomplete verification stack.

critical_concerns.description: Forge's authoritative realized portfolio-alpha t_NW_lag3 is 2.3497, below the Harvey 2.95 hurdle, yet the package does not provide the required CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 5-spec confirmation; a single KOSPI200 active-series t-stat is not enough.
MDD is 0.5879, breaching the base hard constraint MDD < 45%. Reporting Gate C failure without elevating the MDD hard fail understates the rejection reason.

No same-period recomputed baseline, mega05_comparison, or baseline DSR penalty evidence was found. Comparing the FLOW sleeve only against KOSPI200 is not the same-period same-cost same-DSR fairness audit required for Forge.

Forge realized DSR is absent and no candidates_tried penalty is applied to the realized result or baseline. Alpha disclosed 15 factor-level trials and optimizer disclosed 11 sleeve configs, so a zero/omitted penalty is not defensible.

Turnover accounting is internally inconsistent: forge_package_draft reports ann_turnover=2.4441, run_all computes half-L1 then charges cost with x2, while official 06_metrics.csv reports Annualized_Turnover=163.296. A hard turnover gate cannot rely on mutually inconsistent conventions.

The requested canonical artifacts are missing at qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260529_001/weights.csv, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260529_001, and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260529_001. The actual variant path has 76 dates and is not a single snapshot, but schedule density is 76/226=0.336 and monthly_returns.parquet is not emitted.

Forge backtests only the 20-name FLOW sleeve, while optimization selected or analyzed a STR_1715 55% + FLOW 45% book whose union is 38 names and requires Q-Lead architecture resolution. A sleeve-only Forge result does not validate the selected book-level portfolio under the max_names hard mandate.

Latest weights and covariance universes still mismatch: weights include A014820, while covariance.parquet includes A112610 instead. Forge strategy_spec still says Sigma w=1, but the handed-off Sigma does not cover the final selected holdings.

Lockbox chart continuity appears present, but Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined three-way metrics are absent and sr_lockbox_daily_harness is null. A visible post-lockbox line is not a complete sealed-lockbox report.

supporting_arguments: MD5 audit matches package claims for alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260529_001_FLOW/weights.csv.
The actual FLOW weights.csv has 76 as_of_dates, 20 names per date, sum_w=1.0, and 0.05 per-name weights.
FLOW alpha_scores.parquet is time-series, not single snapshot: 67,330 rows, 226 dates, 2005-01-31 to 2023-10-31, clean Date/Ticker/alpha_score/confidence columns.
covariance.parquet is numerically clean for its own universe: 20x20 symmetric PSD, min eigenvalue 0.104625, condition number 6.500452.
equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png exist and are non-empty PNG artifacts.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the canonical artifact namespace is the user-specified WT path or the variant FLOW path.
Whether max_names=20 is enforced at final book level or only per sleeve; base hard constraints imply final book.
Whether quarterly schedule density 0.336 is an accepted infeasibility or an unresolved schedule-fidelity failure.
Whether Forge should validate the FLOW sleeve only or the optimizer's 55/45 STR_1715+FLOW book.
Whether turnover hard-cap evidence should use half-L1, full-L1 round-trip, or the official contract metric.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest assumption is that a failed FLOW sleeve-only realized backtest can serve as an admission-grade Forge artifact despite Gate C failure, MDD hard breach, missing 5-spec/DSR/baseline audits, and unresolved book-level max_names architecture.
rebuttal_required: Emit CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR.
Provide same-period same-cost same-DSR baseline recomputation, not only benchmark active returns.
Reconcile turnover into one convention and regenerate official backtest_result turnover metrics.
Report Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined metrics separately.
If the selected portfolio is 55/45 STR_1715+FLOW, emit combined book weights and prove max_names<=20; otherwise label Forge as FLOW-sleeve-only research fail.
Publish canonical artifact paths or update the WT contract so AX-008 triangulation can verify the intended files.
rationalization_red_flags: Quarterly cadence is FORCED by TO hard cap

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package is partly honest about Gate C failure, but Forge approval still fails because hard MDD, 5-spec, DSR, baseline fairness, canonical artifact, and book-level mandate checks are unresolved.

walk-forward 시계열 충분 (>=60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? Yes for FLOW weights.csv, but schedule density remains 0.336.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Likely yes from generated chart/code, but three-way lockbox metrics are absent.
baseline 비교가 same-period same-cost same-DSR-penalty인가? No evidence found.
